zh.name: 服装多色穿搭与细节展示
zh.summary: 把同款的配色、搭配和细节放进一组。
zh.useWhen: 适合同一款服装推出多种颜色的上新帖。
zh.instructions: 上传不同颜色的上身照和细节，填写卖点。
zh.output: 多色穿搭和细节对比图。

en.name: Clothing Colorways and Styling Details
en.summary: Turn your product photos into a TikTok Shop carousel about clothing Colorways and Styling Details.
en.useWhen: For clothing launches with several colorways.
en.instructions: Upload product and reference photos, then add verified details.
en.output: An editable TikTok Shop carousel with clothing Colorways and Styling Details.
